purpose: Machine-readable theorem/claim registry: one file per claim under claims/, with the shared vocabularies here. Use dependencies/implies as a theorem dependency graph; resolve a branch with `python py/registry.py show <ID> --deps --proof` rather than reading the directory linearly. Indexes are generated by `py/registry.py reindex`, never hand-maintained.

status_definitions.bridge: Direct synthesis or translation of established results into ScoreQuant notation/problem.
status_definitions.project_proved: Derived in the project and currently treated as proved internally; not yet publication-audited.
status_definitions.counterexample: An explicit example falsifies the stated/generalized claim.
status_definitions.measured: Supported by empirical/regression evidence only (see NUMERICAL_EVIDENCE.md); not a proof.

publication_status_definitions.published: Result is attributed to external published literature.
publication_status_definitions.internal: Internal project result; requires external proof/prior-art audit.

literature_search_status_definitions.not_searched: No targeted prior-art search has been run for this claim.
literature_search_status_definitions.search_gap: Targeted prior-art search found no direct precedent; recorded in LITERATURE/; not a novelty claim.
literature_search_status_definitions.prior_art_found: Direct or near-direct precedent located; see the literature entry cited by the claim.

formal_proof_contract.meaning: Optional machine-checked evidence attached to the canonical claim. It does not replace status, publication_status, proof_location, or an informal statement audit, and it certifies the stated theorem only - never the Python/JAX implementation of it.
formal_proof_contract.spec_rule: spec names the frozen statement boundary, which a prover may not edit after the statement audit. A claim whose statement is not separately frozen and audited does not carry formal_proof, even when a Lean proof of it exists.

primary_application: multicomponent linear/template fitting, especially HEP component weights/yields
required_outputs: deployable hard quantizer for new observations
D or Ds information efficiency relative to unbinned inference

Alsing-Wandelt-2019.title: Nuisance Hardened Data Compression for Fast Likelihood-Free Inference

Anderson-2003.title: An Introduction to Multivariate Statistical Analysis
Anderson-2003.note: T. W. Anderson, Wiley, 3rd ed. 2003 (2nd ed. 1984). Generalized variance s7.5, LR criterion s8.3-8.5, MANOVA s8.9, canonical correlations ch. 12, asymptotic roots s13.5-13.6. Registered 5 Sep 2026; 2nd-ed. contents scan (papers/local/); 3rd-ed. numbering unverified.

Barnes-Han-Ozgur-2018.title: A Geometric Characterization of Fisher Information from Quantized Samples with Applications to Distributed Statistical Estimation

Barnes-Han-Ozgur-2020.title: Lower Bounds for Learning Distributions under Communication Constraints via Fisher Information

Bhattacharya-Ghosh-1978.title: On the validity of the formal Edgeworth expansion
Bhattacharya-Ghosh-1978.note: R. N. Bhattacharya and J. K. Ghosh, Annals of Statistics 6(2):434-451, 1978. Edgeworth validity for smooth functions of sample-mean vectors; backdrop of the O6.7 second-order readings. Registered 5 Sep 2026 (audit); abstract read.

Bickel-Klaassen-Ritov-Wellner-1993.title: Efficient and Adaptive Estimation for Semiparametric Models
Bickel-Klaassen-Ritov-Wellner-1993.note: Johns Hopkins University Press 1993; Springer reprint 1998. Classical source for the efficient score as the L2 residual after projection onto the nuisance tangent space and for least-favourable-direction orthogonality. It supplies the statistical interpretation of the full-data residual score used around DS17, but not the binned tilt-residual identity, endogenous tilt fixed point, or any hard-partition obstruction.

Blanchard-Jaffe-Zhivotovskiy-2025.title: Consistency and inconsistency in k-means clustering
Blanchard-Jaffe-Zhivotovskiy-2025.note: Empirical k-means centers can fail to converge under finite first moment even with a unique population optimum (extreme cluster imbalance); consistency restored by an a priori balance constraint. Closest published structure to DS15 Proposition 6 (constraints at negligible asymptotic cost), but repairs a moment pathology rather than the optimizer-driven degeneracy DS15 proves; scalar distortion only. Engage before publication.

Bucklew-Wise-1982.title: Multidimensional Asymptotic Quantization Theory with rth Power Distortion Measures

CMS-2025.title: Development of systematic uncertainty-aware neural network trainings for binned-likelihood analyses at the LHC

Carstensen-1983.title: Complexity of some parametric integer and network programming problems
Carstensen-1983.note: Ph.D. thesis, University of Michigan, 1983. Secondary record only (2 Sep 2026): cited by Gajjar-Radhakrishnan 2019 and by the 2025 linear-parametric optimisation survey arXiv:2501.11544 for n^{Omega(log n)} breakpoints of a linear-parametric shortest path with matching n^{O(log n)} upper bound. Envelope-materialisation warning; no bound for the tilted interval-segmentation DP.

Coleman-et-al-1999.title: Some computational issues in cluster analysis with no a priori metric

Cramer-1946.title: Mathematical Methods of Statistics
Cramer-1946.note: H. Cramer, Princeton University Press, 1946. Chapter 28 (asymptotic properties of sampling distributions), functions of sample moments: the classical normal limit for smooth functions of sample moments. Registered 5 Sep 2026 from memory; section numbering unverified.

Cramer-Nicewander-1979.title: Some symmetric, invariant measures of multivariate association
Cramer-Nicewander-1979.note: E. M. Cramer, W. A. Nicewander, Psychometrika 44(1):43-54, 1979. Symmetric invariant association measures are functions of the canonical correlations. Registered 5 Sep 2026; abstract read.

Cranmer-Pavez-Louppe-2015.title: Approximating Likelihood Ratios with Calibrated Discriminative Classifiers

Donner-Koval-1980.title: The large sample variance of an intraclass correlation
Donner-Koval-1980.note: A. Donner and J. J. Koval, Biometrika 67(3):719-722, 1980. Delta-method variance of a between-over-total ratio under a normal random-effects model; nearest applied kin of O6. Registered 5 Sep 2026 (audit); journal record.

Du-Faber-Gunzburger-1999.title: Centroidal Voronoi Tessellations: Applications and Algorithms

Dulek-2023.title: On the Optimality of Sufficient Statistics-Based Quantizers

Esary-Proschan-Walkup-1967.title: Association of Random Variables, with Applications
Esary-Proschan-Walkup-1967.note: Ann. Math. Statist. 38(5):1466-1474. Defines association through nonnegative covariance of coordinatewise nondecreasing transforms and proves closure properties. Historical source for the covariance-sign language only; Jakubowski 2021, not this paper or FKG, is the direct equality-case source consumed by the DS17 conditional Chebyshev step.

Fang-Krishnaiah-1982.title: Asymptotic distributions of functions of the eigenvalues of some random matrices for nonnormal populations
Fang-Krishnaiah-1982.note: C. Fang, P. R. Krishnaiah, J. Multivariate Anal. 12(1):39-63, 1982. Registered 5 Sep 2026; journal record only, text unread.

Farias-Brossier-2013.title: Optimal Scalar Quantization for Parameter Estimation

Fisher-1958.title: On Grouping for Maximum Homogeneity
Fisher-1958.note: JASA 53(284):789-798 (verbatim-verified 30 Aug 2026). Optimal 1-D weighted SSE partitions are contiguous (appendix proof); reduction to C(K-1,G-1) contiguous partitions - the classical anchor for the scalar interval optimum and exact DP step (DS8, DS15 Proposition 4). Credits the continuous analogue to Dalenius 1950 and Cox 1957.

Flury-1990.title: Principal points
Flury-1990.note: Biometrika 77(1):33-41; primary text read in the DS17 audit. Defines principal points as global squared-error minimizers. Proves the two-point elliptical solution lies on a leading covariance eigenvector and the general rank bound dim span{xi_j-mu} <= k-1; for k>2 the leading principal-subspace statement is explicitly a conjecture, later proved for principal points by Tarpey-Li-Flury 1995. No general existence theorem, arbitrary self-consistent-point theorem, nuisance block, or profiled objective.

Friedman-Rubin-1967.title: On Some Invariant Criteria for Grouping Data

Gajjar-Radhakrishnan-2019.title: Parametric Shortest Paths in Planar Graphs
Gajjar-Radhakrishnan-2019.note: FOCS 2019:876-895. Constructs linear-parameter planar shortest-path instances with n^{Omega(log n)} optimal-cost pieces. This is a parametric-DP envelope-complexity warning, not a lower bound for the restricted tilted interval-segmentation DP.

Garcia-Escudero-Gordaliza-1999.title: Robustness Properties of k Means and Trimmed k Means
Garcia-Escudero-Gordaliza-1999.note: JASA 94:956-969. k-means non-robustness: contamination drives a cluster to chase an outlier; trimming repairs it.

Graf-Luschgy-2000.title: Foundations of Quantization for Probability Distributions
Graf-Luschgy-2000.note: Springer LNM 1730. Every cell of an optimal quantizer has positive mass and null boundaries (content secondary-verified via Roychowdhury Prop 1.1 and Liu-Pages 2020, who pin the null-boundary statement to Thm 4.2 and existence to Thm 4.12; the "Thm 4.1" numbering for positive mass is unverified - 30 Aug 2026 audit); Thm 5.1: uniqueness of the scalar log-concave K-quantizer (numbering and content confirmed twice at secondary level).

Gronlund-etal-2017.title: Fast Exact k-Means, k-Medians and Bregman Divergence Clustering in 1D
Gronlund-etal-2017.note: Gronlund, Larsen, Mathiasen, Nielsen, Schneider, Song; arXiv:1701.07204 v4 (2018). Primary text pp. 1-2 read 2 Sep 2026. The contiguous 1-D k-means DP runs in O(kn^2), and in O(n log n + kn) (O(kn) on sorted input) by monotone-matrix search; the weighted discrete scalar quantization form is covered. Improves DS19.2's fixed-tilt O(KN^2) evaluation bound to O(KN) after sorting.

Hall-1992.title: The Bootstrap and Edgeworth Expansion
Hall-1992.note: P. Hall, Springer, 1992. Smooth function model; studentized-statistic skewness explains the small-n under-coverage of plug-in Wald intervals. Registered 5 Sep 2026 (audit); record only.

Hampel-Ronchetti-Rousseeuw-Stahel-1986.title: Robust Statistics: The Approach Based on Influence Functions
Hampel-Ronchetti-Rousseeuw-Stahel-1986.note: F. R. Hampel, E. M. Ronchetti, P. J. Rousseeuw, W. A. Stahel, Wiley, 1986. Asymptotic variance of a statistical functional as the integral of its squared influence function, V(T,F) = int IF^2 dF, the formula O6.2's sigma^2 = E[psi^2] instantiates. Registered 5 Sep 2026; section number unverified.

Hastie-Stuetzle-1989.title: Principal Curves
Hastie-Stuetzle-1989.note: JASA 84(406):502-516. Introduced self-consistent curves; Tarpey-Flury 1996 explicitly credits this source for the self-consistency terminology before generalizing it to random vectors, principal points, and other summaries.

Hennig-2004.title: Breakdown points for maximum likelihood estimators of location-scale mixtures
Hennig-2004.note: Ann. Statist. 32:1313-1340. A far-enough added point forms a one-point cluster at the exact fixed-K clustering optimum (secondary-verified via Hennig arXiv:2308.14478).

Jakubowski-2021.title: A complement to the Chebyshev integral inequality
Jakubowski-2021.note: Statistics & Probability Letters 168:108934. Theorem 1.2 gives the exact equality case for monotone covariance: Cov(f(X),g(X))=0 iff f(X) or g(X) is a.s. constant. The proof uses the independent-copy product identity appearing conditionally in DS17. This supports that equality step, not the later quantizer-cell or nuisance-rank conclusions.

Jiang-et-al-2026.title: Direct target localization in USNs with hybrid quantized multi-snapshot measurements: A geometric structure-aided approach

Kelley-2007.title: Confidence intervals for standardized effect sizes: theory, application, and implementation
Kelley-2007.note: K. Kelley, Journal of Statistical Software 20(8), 2007. Noncentral-F intervals for eta-squared and R-squared under normal-theory ANOVA; the normality assumption O6 avoids. Registered 5 Sep 2026; verified at jstatsoft.org.

Kendall-Stuart-1961.title: The Advanced Theory of Statistics, Vol. 2: Inference and Relationship
Kendall-Stuart-1961.note: M. G. Kendall, A. Stuart, Griffin, 1961. Ch. 26 s26.21-26.24: correlation ratio, decomposition (26.50), normal-theory F tests; no large-sample variance. Registered 5 Sep 2026; primary text (archive.org OCR).

Kiefer-1974.title: General Equivalence Theory for Optimum Designs (Approximate Theory)

Kiefer-Wolfowitz-1960.title: The Equivalence of Two Extremum Problems

Kieffer-1983.title: Uniqueness of locally optimal quantizer for log-concave density and convex error weighting function
Kieffer-1983.note: IEEE Trans. IT 29:42-47. Log-concave source + convex strictly increasing C1 error weight: unique locally optimal scalar quantizer (hence globally optimal); Gaussian covered. Secondary-verified via Kazikli et al. arXiv:2012.08265 Thm 3 and Liu-Pages-2020 Lemma 10.

Levrard-2015.title: Nonasymptotic bounds for vector quantization in Hilbert spaces
Levrard-2015.note: AOS 43(2):592-619. Definition 2.1 margin condition: p(t) <= (B p_min / 128 M^2) t on the mass of t-neighborhoods of optimal-cell boundaries - a hypothesis on the LAW at population optima, never proven at empirical optima; buys finite optimal-codebook sets, quadratic growth, and 1/n rates; Gaussian mixtures satisfy it. (arXiv 1405.6672; the earlier arXiv 1310.7138 "Margin conditions for vector quantization" is the 2013 precursor.)

Li-Mathias-2000.title: Extremal Characterizations of the Schur Complement and Resulting Inequalities
Li-Mathias-2000.note: SIAM Review 42(2):233-246. Theorem 2.2 is the DS11 identity (Loewner-minimal generalized Schur complement with exact attainment set); attributed to M. G. Krein (1947) and Anderson's shorted operator (1971).

Liu-Pages-2020.title: Convergence rate of optimal quantization and application to the clustering performance of the empirical measure
Liu-Pages-2020.note: JMLR 21(86):1-36. Lemma 10: strongly unimodal law has a unique stationary (hence optimal) scalar K-quantizer; Prop 11: positive-definite distortion Hessian at the optimum under strict log-concavity.

Magnus-Neudecker-1999.title: Matrix Differential Calculus with Applications in Statistics and Econometrics
Magnus-Neudecker-1999.note: J. R. Magnus, H. Neudecker, Wiley, 1988/1999 (3rd ed. 2019). Ch. 8 s8.3 differential of a determinant, s8.4 of an inverse. Registered 5 Sep 2026; contents scan (papers/local/).

Mease-Nair-2006.title: Unique optimal partitions of distributions and connections to hazard rates and stochastic ordering
Mease-Nair-2006.note: Statistica Sinica 16:1299-1312 (verbatim-verified 30 Aug 2026). Confirms scalar-quantizer uniqueness under log-concavity of the density via likelihood-ratio ordering, and refutes Eubank-1988 weaker sufficient condition by an explicit three-stationary-solution counterexample: DS15 assumption (S) must stay pinned to log-concavity of the density itself.

Megiddo-1983.title: Applying Parallel Computation Algorithms in the Design of Serial Algorithms
Megiddo-1983.note: J. ACM 30(4):852-865 (primary record checked 2 Sep 2026). Parametric search: simulate a comparison algorithm at the unknown optimal parameter and resolve comparisons at polynomial roots with a monotone sign oracle. At d_lambda=1 it lifts the fixed-tilt interval DP to an arithmetic-polynomial exact minimiser of the tilt dual; bit complexity is not analysed there (AUDIT-DS-PRACTICAL-CERTIFIED-SOLVER supplies it).

Muirhead-Waternaux-1980.title: Asymptotic distributions in canonical correlation analysis and other multivariate procedures for nonnormal populations
Muirhead-Waternaux-1980.note: R. J. Muirhead, C. M. Waternaux, Biometrika 67(1):31-43, 1980. Canonical-correlation asymptotics under finite fourth moments. Registered 5 Sep 2026; abstract read.

Pukelsheim-Titterington-1983.title: General Differential and Lagrangian Theory for Optimal Experimental Design
Pukelsheim-Titterington-1983.note: Ann. Statist. 11(4):1060-1068 (primary record checked 2 Sep 2026). Subgradient and Lagrangian duality for information functionals, including subset-parameter (D_s) criteria, over the convex set of design measures. Comparison template for DS19's certificate; its strong duality needs the convex feasible set that hard partitions lack.

Radhakrishnan-Kshirsagar-1981.title: Influence functions for certain parameters in multivariate analysis
Radhakrishnan-Kshirsagar-1981.note: R. Radhakrishnan, A. M. Kshirsagar, Comm. Statist. Theory Methods 10(6):515-529, 1981. Influence functions of the generalized variance, the MANOVA noncentrality matrix and its eigenvalues, canonical correlations, Wilks' Lambda. Registered 5 Sep 2026 (vector-packet literature pass); abstract read.

Rakhlin-Caponnetto-2006.title: Stability of K-Means Clustering
Rakhlin-Caponnetto-2006.note: NeurIPS 19. For bounded sources and nearest-center squared-error codebooks, uniqueness of the population minimizer forces the population almost-minimizer set to shrink; a covering-number uniform law transfers this to empirical stability. Direct prior art for DS16.1's codebook-rigidity ingredient, but not for arbitrary groupings or nuisance moments.

Robin-Smith-2000.title: Tests of rank
Robin-Smith-2000.note: J.-M. Robin and R. J. Smith, Econometric Theory 16(2):151-175, 2000. Rank tests built on the smallest estimated characteristic roots of a matrix with population rank r; the limiting law is a weighted sum of independent chi-squared variables, the trace-form kin of the rank-deficient determinant limit in O7.4(b). Registered 6 Sep 2026 (audit); abstract verified.

Romanazzi-1992.title: Influence in canonical correlation analysis
Romanazzi-1992.note: M. Romanazzi, Psychometrika 57(2):237-259, 1992. Influence function of each squared canonical correlation via generalized-eigenproblem perturbation. Registered 5 Sep 2026; abstract read.

Sabin-Gray-1986.title: Global convergence and empirical consistency of the generalized Lloyd algorithm
Sabin-Gray-1986.note: IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 32(2):148-155. Establishes set convergence of generalized Lloyd fixed-point quantizers and empirical consistency under source-independent convex additive distortions. Structural precedent for empirical quantizer transfer, but not for a profiled Fisher objective, nuisance Schur complement, or exact finite one-point stability.

Scott-Symons-1971.title: Clustering Methods Based on Likelihood Ratio Criteria

Seo-Kanda-Fujikoshi-1995.title: The effects of nonnormality on tests for dimensionality in canonical correlation and MANOVA models
Seo-Kanda-Fujikoshi-1995.note: T. Seo, T. Kanda, Y. Fujikoshi, J. Multivariate Anal. 52(2):325-337, 1995. The singular-I_Z endpoint as a dimensionality test. Registered 5 Sep 2026; journal record.

Serfling-1980.title: Approximation Theorems of Mathematical Statistics
Serfling-1980.note: R. J. Serfling, Wiley, 1980. Chapter 3 (transformations of given statistics), Section 3.3 Theorem B: multivariate delta method for functions of asymptotically normal vectors. Registered 5 Sep 2026; Theorem B corroborated by secondary citations, Theorem A label unverified.

Serinko-Babu-1992.title: Weak limit theorems for univariate k-mean clustering under a nonregular condition
Serinko-Babu-1992.note: J. Multivariate Anal. 41(2):273-296; primary PDF read verbatim. 1-D interval-partition (split-function) formulation of population k-means; the unique global optimizer with singular Hessian yields nonstandard n^{1/4} rates (double exponential, k=2). Nearest precedent for degeneracy AT a 1-D self-consistent partition optimum; describes what happens when degeneracy occurs for one law, never a class-wide forcing theorem like DS17.

Sibson-Kenny-1975.title: Coefficients in D-Optimal Experimental Design
Sibson-Kenny-1975.note: JRSS-B 37:288-292. With Atwood's inequality: D-optimal design weights are bounded ABOVE by 1/k; no published lower bound found.

Silvey-1978.title: Optimal design measures with singular information matrices
Silvey-1978.note: Biometrika 65:553-559 (secondary-verified). Ds-optimal designs can carry singular full information matrices - the design-side analogue of the (M3) failure at Ds-optimal partitions (DS15).

Silvey-Titterington-1973.title: A Geometric Approach to Optimal Design Theory
Silvey-Titterington-1973.note: Biometrika 60(1):21-32. The publisher summary identifies D- and Ds-equivalence as duality theorems proved through Strong Lagrangian Theory on the approximate-design feasible set; this does not transfer strong duality to hard partitions.

Silvey-Titterington-Torsney-1978.title: An Algorithm for Optimal Designs on a Design Space

Spaeth-1977.title: Computational experiences with the exchange method: Applied to four commonly used partitioning cluster analysis criteria

Spaeth-1985.title: Cluster Dissection and Analysis: Theory, FORTRAN Programs, Examples

Sugiura-Fujikoshi-1969.title: Asymptotic expansions of the non-null distributions of the likelihood ratio criteria for multivariate linear hypothesis and independence
Sugiura-Fujikoshi-1969.note: N. Sugiura, Y. Fujikoshi, Ann. Math. Statist. 40(3):942-952, 1969. Fixed-alternative expansion of the determinant-ratio criterion, normal theory. Registered 5 Sep 2026; abstract read.

Tarpey-Flury-1996.title: Self-consistency: a fundamental concept in statistics
Tarpey-Flury-1996.note: Statistical Science 11(3):229-243; primary text reviewed in the DS17 audit. Credits Hastie-Stuetzle 1989 for the terminology and defines random-vector self-consistency E[X|Y]=Y. Theorem 4.1: under linear conditional means, if a self-consistent Y is measurable with respect to the orthogonal projection onto its q-dimensional support span, that span is generated by q covariance eigenvectors (not necessarily the leading q). This is the closest LCM structural antecedent, but has no endogenous tilt, profiled information, or nuisance-rank obstruction.

Tarpey-Li-Flury-1995.title: Principal points and self-consistent points of elliptical distributions
Tarpey-Li-Flury-1995.note: Ann. Statist. 23(1):103-112. The principal-subspace theorem proves that if n principal points of a centered elliptical law span dimension q, their span is the leading q-eigenspace. Tarpey-Flury 1996 identifies this as the finite-distinct-support special case of its broader self-consistency theorem, whose arbitrary self-consistent conclusion is only an eigenvector span, not necessarily leading. Closest published geometric cousin of DS17, but no nuisance/profiled block, endogenous tilt, conditional-centering class, or nonexistence theorem. Primary proof remains library-access pending.

Tarpey-Loperfido-2015.title: Self-consistency and a generalized principal subspace theorem
Tarpey-Loperfido-2015.note: J. Multivariate Anal. 133:27-37. Generalizes principal-subspace results using self-consistency, including location-mixture and skew-normal settings. Forward-citation near miss for DS17's beyond-elliptical axis: it broadens the distribution classes supporting subspace restrictions, but still optimizes squared approximation error and contains no profiled Fisher block, endogenous tilt equation, or margin-certified empirical obstruction. Abstract and theorem context screened; primary theorem text remains library-access pending.

Taskinen-Croux-Kankainen-Ollila-Oja-2006.title: Influence functions and efficiencies of the canonical correlation and canonical vectors estimates
Taskinen-Croux-Kankainen-Ollila-Oja-2006.note: S. Taskinen, C. Croux, A. Kankainen, E. Ollila and H. Oja, Journal of Multivariate Analysis 97(2):359-384, 2006. Restates the influence function of a squared canonical correlation, IF(rho_i^2) = 2 rho_i u_i v_i - rho_i^2 (u_i^2 + v_i^2) in the canonical variates, the form O7.2's per-coefficient check uses. Registered 6 Sep 2026 (audit); formula seen only through a citing restatement (arXiv:1705.04194).

Telgarsky-Vattani-2010.title: Hartigan's Method: k-means Clustering without Voronoi
Telgarsky-Vattani-2010.note: AISTATS 2010, PMLR 9:820-827. Finite one-point relocation geometry and separation from the induced Voronoi partition for ordinary k-means; no profiled-Fisher or population-funnel result.

Toledo-1993.title: Maximizing Non-Linear Concave Functions in Fixed Dimension
Toledo-1993.note: In Complexity in Numerical Optimization (Pardalos ed.), World Scientific 1993, pp. 429-447; extended abstract FOCS 1992. Primary text (abstract, section 1, section 2 definitions) read 2 Sep 2026. Fixed dimension d, piecewise polynomial concave F over a convex set, evaluator whose branches depend on signs of bounded-degree polynomials: max F and a maximiser in time polynomial in the evaluator's arithmetic operations (RAM model). With F=-v_K and the degree-2 interval DP as evaluator this settles fixed d_lambda, variable K exact minimisation of the tilt dual in arithmetic complexity; bit complexity is not covered.

Valassi-2020.title: Optimising HEP parameter fits via Monte Carlo weight derivative regression
Valassi-2020.note: CHEP2019 proceedings (EPJ Web of Conferences). Local copy: papers/valassi_2020_weight_derivative_regression_arXiv2003.12853.pdf

Venkitasubramaniam-Tong-Swami-2007.title: Quantization for Maximin ARE in Distributed Estimation

Wang-Song-2011.title: Ckmeans.1d.dp: Optimal k-means Clustering in One Dimension by Dynamic Programming
Wang-Song-2011.note: The R Journal 3(2):29-33 (primary record checked 2 Sep 2026). The O(kn^2)-time, O(kn)-space contiguous DP that DS19.2's fixed-tilt evaluation describes.

Wang-Yang-Stufken-2019.title: Information-Based Optimal Subdata Selection for Big Data Linear Regression
Wang-Yang-Stufken-2019.note: D-determinant over an i.i.d. sample is maximized by extreme order statistics; per-point information scale 2 log n for normal covariates (Thm 2, 6).

Whittle-1973.title: Some General Points in the Theory of Optimal Experimental Design

Wishart-1932.title: A note on the distribution of the correlation ratio
Wishart-1932.note: J. Wishart, Biometrika 24(3/4):441-456, 1932. Normal-theory exact distribution of the sample correlation ratio; establishes the eta-squared lineage of O6's uncentred ratio but does not transfer (normality, centred ratio). Registered 5 Sep 2026; existence verified from the Biometrika contents index, text not read.

Wynn-1970.title: The Sequential Generation of D-Optimum Experimental Designs

Wynn-1972.title: Results in the Theory and Construction of D-Optimum Experimental Designs

Zador-1982.title: Asymptotic Quantization Error of Continuous Signals and the Quantization Dimension

Zhang-Blum-Kaplan-Lu-2018.title: A Fundamental Limitation on Maximum Parameter Dimension for Accurate Estimation With Quantized Data

deCastro-Dorigo-2019.title: INFERNO: Inference-Aware Neural Optimisation
deCastro-Dorigo-2019.note: Comput. Phys. Commun. 244:170. Differentiable Asimov-likelihood loss built from the inverse Hessian of a softened histogram -- a profiled-Fisher surrogate -- optimised over neural summaries. Closest applied statement of the DS18 objective; soft histogram, no hard partition and no optimality theorem (31 Aug 2026 DS18 audit).

vanderVaart-1998.title: Asymptotic Statistics
vanderVaart-1998.note: A. W. van der Vaart, Cambridge University Press, 1998. Theorem 3.1 (delta method) and the Chapter 3 sample-variance example under a finite fourth moment are the template for O6.2; Chapter 5 (M- and Z-estimators, Theorem 5.23) for plug-in sandwich variances. Registered 5 Sep 2026; theorem numbers verified via secondary quotations, no page access.

read_order: README.md defines the single canonical read order; follow it rather than any local copy.
rules: Resolve a claim with `python py/registry.py show <ID> --deps --proof`.
Browse claims/INDEX.md (generated) to pick work; it is grouped by programme in queue order.
Never hand-edit an index; run `python py/registry.py reindex`.
Run `python py/registry.py validate` before finishing a session.
